Giveffect brings your development teams together with easy to use software that combines 10 systems in one. Increase team collaboration by using a single software that seamlessly connects and automates your data between departments.

about_short_description.short_description: Giveffect builds modern nonprofit software for CRM, fundraising, volunteer, and donor management to streamline administration tasks.

product.name: Relationship Management Database
product.description: A centralized database to store and track supporter information including donor, volunteer, event participation, and fundraising history.

product.name: Online & Offline Giving System
product.description: A platform to accept and track various types of donations including online, offline, crypto, stock, and donor-advised funds.

product.name: Events & Fundraising System
product.description: A tool to create, manage, and track fundraising events and campaigns including ticket sales, peer-to-peer, crowdfunding, auctions, and sponsorships.

product.name: Volunteer Management System
product.description: A platform to schedule, manage, and track volunteers including applications, shift sign-ups, hours tracking, and communication.

product.name: Smart Automation
product.description: Automation tools that reduce manual data entry and administrative tasks by automating workflows, tax receipt generation, and communication.

product.name: Marketing & Communications
product.description: Tools for segmented and personalized email, direct mail, and text messaging campaigns integrated with the CRM for supporter engagement.
